#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n >> s;

    bool parenthesized = false;
    int outsideLongest = 0;
    int innerWords = 0;
    int cur = 0;

    for (int idx = 0; idx < n; ++idx) {
        char ch = s[idx];
        if (ch == '_') {
            if (parenthesized) {
                if (cur > 0) {
                    innerWords++;
                }
            } else {
                outsideLongest = std::max(outsideLongest, cur);
            }
            cur = 0;
        } else if (ch == '(') {
            parenthesized = true;
            outsideLongest = std::max(outsideLongest, cur);
            cur = 0;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            parenthesized = false;
            if (cur > 0) {
                innerWords++;
            }
            cur = 0;
        } else {
            cur++;
        }
    }

    outsideLongest = std::max(outsideLongest, cur);
    std::cout << outsideLongest << " " << innerWords << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
